name: dsh-wsl
description: WSL: three tools that let the agent test the POSIX half of this pack on a Windows machine - `wsl_status` (distributions, the default, and whether a distribution can run a check), `wsl_run` (one argv array in a distribution, with its exit code, a deadline and a tree kill) and `wsl_path` (`C:\...` <-> `/mnt/c/...`). Host-only, argv-only, no shell string, no bridged port. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundled, no network egress.
